question: Does the exact four-cell enemy Cracked-by-Dimmed lattice contain a structurally distinct, naturally authored and unclosed joint consumer, or is its sole both-status route only an alias of exhausted Cracked and Dimmed families?
registrationStatus: Frozen before the first decision execution. Exact current-main source was used only to construct the complete source inventory; no trace, cache, support metric, simulator observation, ledger mutation, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser was read or used.

cracked.off: The selected living enemy has vulnerable <= 0.
cracked.on: The selected living enemy has vulnerable > 0.

dimmed.off: The same selected living enemy has weak <= 0.
dimmed.on: The same selected living enemy has weak > 0.

factorDefinitions.payoffs: No Scoreline, Afterimage, damage, action-economy, Facet, Shatter, healing, Ward or other payoff is constructed, varied or estimated.

statusReadInventory.subject: enemy
statusReadInventory.expression: var echo: int = 2 if target.staggered or _sget(target.statuses, "vulnerable") > 0 else 1

aliasStructure.neither: No enemy Cracked or Dimmed condition exists.
aliasStructure.cracked-only: Eclipse Slash and every current enemy-Cracked consumer are covered by immutable Cracked tempo, Resonance and Facet evidence.
aliasStructure.dimmed-only: Dimming Cut, Ringing Blow and the target-Dimmed-to-Facet and weak-mend directions are closed without narrower producer, consumer or payoff variants.
aliasStructure.both: Shatterhymn is already a producer in both closed Cracked protocols and the complete closed Dimmed producer class. Current-main has no branch consuming both statuses on the same enemy. Reusing a closed payoff would be a forbidden subset; selecting a different payoff would be an unsupported invented mechanism rather than evidence-backed narrowing.

decisionRules.futilityRule: At boundary 2, close the complete Cracked-by-Dimmed conjunction when all four producer cells are complete, Shatterhymn is the sole both-status producer, it belongs to both closed source classes, current-main contains no joint enemy-status consumer and every same-payoff continuation is a forbidden narrower variant.
decisionRules.inconclusiveRule: At boundary 3, record inconclusive and stop if source, evidence, ledger identity or the wall-time cap prevents the exact alias decision.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete enemy Cracked-by-Dimmed conjunction as a closed-family alias. Do not subset Shatterhymn, combine sequential producers, reuse damage, action-economy, Facet, Shatter, healing or Ward payoffs, invent another payoff, inspect support, add telemetry, simulate, implement or rerun this lattice.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the lattice audit as inconclusive at cap. Select no representation, inspect no support, add no telemetry or row, and require new authority before repair or rerun.
